metadata.summary: Punit inquired about breakfast options at Manhattan Bagel and the agent searched for available items, finding a Box of Sweets, but the call ended before further discussion or ordering.

messages.text: Hello Punit, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It is great to see you again. How can I help you today?
Say hi. I like to order some, something in breakfast. Can you please suggest me something?
Let me see what we have for breakfast.
I found a Box of Sweets for breakfast. It includes muffins,
